approach: Independent sparse temporal model using only the requested task-table columns. Entity and entity-season tokens are feature-hashed, while strictly past per-entity outcomes, recency, expanding/recent prevalence, and calendar phase form numeric features. A recency-weighted regularized logistic classifier is blended with a smoothed entity rate. Validation uses train labels; test uses train plus validation labels, and row_id preserves query order.
command: python solution.py --task-dir PATH --time-col NAME --entity-col NAME --target-col NAME --split val|test --out FILE
